print.rowText: --print, -pPrint response without interactive mode (see Agent SDK documentation for programmatic usage details). For --resume on a background session that is still running, see Resume a running background sessionclaude -p "query"

format.rowText: --output-formatSpecify output format for print mode (options: text, json, stream-json)claude -p "query" --output-format json

turns.rowText: --max-turnsLimit the number of agentic turns (print mode only). No limit by default. With --input-format stream-json, a message still queued when the limit ends a turn stays queued and starts a new turn with its own limitclaude -p --max-turns 3 "query"
